limitations_and_boundaries: TbMCA and GbMCA as FXR antagonists in humans not yet known.
Differences in human and murine bile acid signaling properties may hamper translational conclusions.
Microbiota differences may explain individual responses to bile acid-derived drugs.
Much more research is needed to target microbiota-bile acid interplay for metabolic disease treatment.
